cleanse.text: They can cleanse CC: don't open with Curse of the Sad Mummy on them — catch someone else or wait for the cleanse to be used.

spell-shield.text: Spell shield blocks Bandage Toss: bait it out (or Q a different target) before engaging.

anti-engage.text: Anti-engage tools punish your dive: flank or wait until their peel is used before you R.

untargetable.text: Untargetable/dodge tools can waste your R: hold it until they have used them.

high-mobility.text: High mobility: hit them with R from fog or a flank — a straight Bandage Toss is easy to dodge.

percent-hp-damage.text: Percent-HP damage shreds tanks: don't stand in front of them for long fights alone.

early-invader.text: Early invader: ward your buff entrances and avoid 1v1s before level 6; ping your laners to cover.

true-damage.text: True damage ignores your resistances: tank stacking helps less, peel for your carries instead.

kite.text: Kiting carry: you need Bandage Toss or R to land first — flank instead of walking at them.

early-game.text: Strong early: track their jungler, farm efficiently and arrive at fights after your level 6.

powerSpikes.note: Dragon's Rage can kick you away from your engage target.

dangerAbilities.name: Dragon's Rage
dangerAbilities.note: Kicks you out of position or into your team.

dangerAbilities.name: Sonic Wave
dangerAbilities.note: Follow-up dash for ganks and invades.

dangerAbilities.name: Safeguard
dangerAbilities.note: Shield/dash to allies and wards — escapes after you engage.

tips.text: Avoid 1v1s with him before level 6; he out-duels you early.
Ward the entrance to your raptors/buff side he is likely to invade.
Match his ganks by counter-ganking; your R + laner wins 2v2 fights.
Late game he falls off; play for teamfights.

itemAdjustments.name: Plated Steelcaps
itemAdjustments.note: Armor against his physical damage if he is ahead.

jungle.note: Enemy Lee Sin is strong level 2–3 — avoid his side early; ward his raptors/buff entrance.

powerSpikes.note: Fast clear + strong duel — common early invader.
First lethality item makes his burst very high.

dangerAbilities.name: Smoke Screen
dangerAbilities.note: Nearsight hides him while he shoots you.

dangerAbilities.name: Quickdraw
dangerAbilities.note: Dash + armor; he kites your Bandage Toss.

tips.text: Never fight him alone in your jungle early; call your laners.
Ward entrances to your camps — he tends to take camps while farming.
In teamfights flank him; he kites well from the front.

jungle.note: Graves farms fast and likes to steal camps — ward your second buff and avoid isolated 1v1s.

powerSpikes.note: Heartbreaker execute + possession resets in fights.

dangerAbilities.name: Sovereign's Domination
dangerAbilities.note: Possessing a dead champion resets him — clean up fights fast.

dangerAbilities.name: Spectral Maw
dangerAbilities.note: Dash stun.

dangerAbilities.name: Harrowed Path
dangerAbilities.note: Camouflage in terrain mist: hard to target with Bandage Toss.

tips.text: Chain CC on him after the first kill in a fight to stop resets.
Keep R for when he possesses someone — he can't escape in that window.
Contest scuttle with your laners; he's weak to coordinated fights.

jungle.note: Viego can contest early but prefers farming; normal warding is enough.

powerSpikes.note: Cease and Desist: unstoppable point-click knockup on your carry.

dangerAbilities.name: Cease and Desist
dangerAbilities.note: Can't be stopped by your CC while charging.

dangerAbilities.name: Denting Blows
dangerAbilities.note: % max HP damage and armor shred against you.

tips.text: Peel your carry from her R with your own Q/R after she lands.
Track her start: she likes level 3 ganks on the side she ends on.
You out-teamfight her later; avoid early 1v1s.

jungle.note: Vi looks for level 3 ganks — warn the lane on her end side.

powerSpikes.note: Form transformation (Rhaast = anti-tank healing, Shadow Assassin = burst).

dangerAbilities.name: Umbral Trespass
dangerAbilities.note: Untargetable inside a champion — dodges your R.

dangerAbilities.name: Shadow Step
dangerAbilities.note: Walks through walls; ganks from unexpected angles.

tips.text: He is weak before his form — gank early to keep his lanes from feeding him orbs.
Against Rhaast, avoid long fights (heals off % of your health).
Wait for Umbral Trespass to be used before your R.

jungle.note: Kayn farms early; low invade risk.

dangerAbilities.name: Taste Their Fear
dangerAbilities.note: Bonus damage on isolated targets — stay near allies.

dangerAbilities.name: Void Assault
dangerAbilities.note: Invisibility; your R can still hit him if he's nearby.

tips.text: Stay near walls/minions or allies to avoid being isolated.
You are tanky — he struggles to kill you; peel for your carries.
Use Despair/R area when he goes invisible nearby.

jungle.note: Kha'Zix can invade an isolated jungler; avoid fighting alone.

powerSpikes.note: Very strong level 3 ganks and duels.

dangerAbilities.name: Cocoon
dangerAbilities.note: Stun skillshot that sets up her burst.

dangerAbilities.name: Rappel
dangerAbilities.note: Spider-form untargetable: dodges Bandage Toss and R.

tips.text: Expect early ganks on your lanes — warn them about her first gank timing.
Hold R until Rappel is on cooldown.
She falls off — survive early and win teamfights.

jungle.note: Elise is dangerous level 2–3 — don't contest her side early.

dangerAbilities.name: Javelin Toss
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range poke that hurts more the farther it travels.

dangerAbilities.name: Bushwhack
dangerAbilities.note: Traps reveal you.

tips.text: Ward your jungle; she invades and steals camps.
Don't walk into Javelin range at low HP.
Flank and catch her with R in teamfights — she is squishy.

jungle.note: Nidalee invades often — ward buffs and avoid low-HP clears in her range.

dangerAbilities.name: Jack In The Box
dangerAbilities.note: Fearing boxes; he pre-places them on your camps.

dangerAbilities.name: Deceive
dangerAbilities.note: Invisibility blink.

tips.text: Buy Oracle Lens early to clear boxes in your jungle.
Keep your laners warned — he ganks early from invisibility.
Your R and Despair hit him even near his clone.

jungle.note: Shaco may invade with boxes — consider starting away from his likely side.

powerSpikes.note: Each mark collected increases her range and damage.

dangerAbilities.name: Lamb's Respite
dangerAbilities.note: Nobody dies inside it — don't waste your R into it.

dangerAbilities.name: Dance of Arrows
dangerAbilities.note: Dash; she kites your engage.

tips.text: Protect the camps she marks; ward and contest with your laners.
Engage after Lamb's Respite is used.
Flank her; she kites frontal engages.

jungle.note: Kindred marks your camps — expect her to come for them.

dangerAbilities.name: Devastating Charge
dangerAbilities.note: Knockback engage.

dangerAbilities.name: Onslaught of Shadows
dangerAbilities.note: AoE fear.

tips.text: He clears fast — match his tempo or counter-gank his first gank.
In teamfights hold your R for after his engage to counter-engage.
Mercury's Treads help against his fear chain.

jungle.note: Hecarim plays for fast clears and early ganks.

powerSpikes.note: Moonfall AoE pull — combo with your R.

dangerAbilities.name: Moonfall
dangerAbilities.note: Pulls everyone near her.

tips.text: She farms before 6: gank lanes early to build a lead.
Don't group tightly against her R.
Mercury's Treads + MR against her magic burst.

jungle.note: Diana usually farms to 6.

dangerAbilities.name: Dragon Strike
dangerAbilities.note: E-Q knockup combo.

dangerAbilities.name: Cataclysm
dangerAbilities.note: Terrain arena that traps your team.

tips.text: Warn laners about his early ganks.
Your R inside his Cataclysm traps them too — use it.
Ward his likely start side.

jungle.note: J4 is strong early in skirmishes.

dangerAbilities.name: Crescent Guard
dangerAbilities.note: Knocks back and blocks damage from outside the circle.

dangerAbilities.name: Three Talon Strike
dangerAbilities.note: Third hit knockup.

tips.text: Avoid 1v1 duels early; he's one of the best early duelists.
Your engage must start inside his Crescent Guard circle.
He falls off later; farm safely and win teamfights.

jungle.note: Xin Zhao is strong level 2–3 — don't contest scuttle alone.

powerSpikes.note: Paranoia: dives your carries from far away.

dangerAbilities.name: Shroud of Darkness
dangerAbilities.note: Spell shield blocks your Bandage Toss.

dangerAbilities.name: Unspeakable Horror
dangerAbilities.note: Fear after a tether.

tips.text: Bait Shroud of Darkness before using Bandage Toss on him.
Group with your carries after his level 6.
Your R is strong against his dive.

jungle.note: Nocturne mostly farms to 6 but can duel early.

dangerAbilities.name: Parallel Convergence
dangerAbilities.note: Delayed stun zone.

dangerAbilities.name: Chronobreak
dangerAbilities.note: Rewinds him out of your engage.

tips.text: Wait for Chronobreak before committing R onto him.
Step out of his W zone before it detonates.
MR boots help against his burst.

jungle.note: Ekko mostly farms early.

dangerAbilities.name: Allure
dangerAbilities.note: Charm after a delay.

dangerAbilities.name: Last Caress
dangerAbilities.note: Untargetable dash back.

tips.text: Gank early: she is weak before level 6.
After 6, sweep/Control Wards your carries' paths.
Your R hits her even when camouflaged.

jungle.note: Evelynn farms to 6 — you can play aggressive early.

dangerAbilities.name: Alpha Strike
dangerAbilities.note: Untargetable — can dodge your R; wait for it.

dangerAbilities.name: Wuju Style
dangerAbilities.note: True damage on attacks.

tips.text: Your R hard-counters his resets — hold it for when he enters the fight.
Gank early to deny his farm.
Don't R while he's in Alpha Strike.

jungle.note: Master Yi farms and scales; you can play aggressive.

dangerAbilities.name: Lilting Lullaby
dangerAbilities.note: Sleeps everyone she marked.

dangerAbilities.name: Swirlseed
dangerAbilities.note: Long-range slow.

tips.text: She kites with speed; land Bandage Toss from fog.
MR against her magic damage.
Avoid long chases; she outruns you.

jungle.note: Lillia clears fast and can contest scuttle.

dangerAbilities.name: Infinite Duress
dangerAbilities.note: Suppression lunge.

dangerAbilities.name: Primal Howl
dangerAbilities.note: Damage reduction + fear.

tips.text: Avoid low-HP fights against him; he heals and gets faster.
Grievous Wounds if he is ahead.
Your R can stop his R engage on your team.

jungle.note: Warwick duels well early and tracks low-HP champions.
